apps.localizedDescription:
Features:

Focus, simply.

• Drag around the dial to set 1–120 minutes, or tap 15 · 25 · 45 · 60. Start morphs into Pause and End in Liquid Glass.
• AlarmKit alarms ring through Silent mode and Focus, with Take a Break right on the alert.
• Label what you're working on (Study, Reading, Deep Work), long breaks every few sessions, and auto-start options.
• Full-screen minimal timer in black or white, portrait or landscape.

iPhone & iPad: Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island (three styles), Home Screen widgets that start sessions, Lock Screen and StandBy widgets, a Control Center and Action Button toggle, Siri and Shortcuts ("Start a focus in Pomly", "How much time is left in Pomly?"), iPad and iPhone Duo layouts.

versions.localizedDescription:
Pomly 1.1: a calm Pomodoro timer for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.

New in 1.1:

• Focus rooms: share a link and focus together, with a quiet "3 people focusing".
• Tasks: pick what each block is for, import from Reminders, then mark it Done or carry it over.
• Calendar (optional, Settings › Advanced): a suggested free gap and sessions logged to a Pomly calendar.
• Weekly insights in History: best hour, how sessions felt, a forgiving streak and a shareable recap card.
• After each session: an optional 1–5 "How did it feel?" and a short break tip.
• Ambient sound: white noise, brown noise or rain while you focus.
• Focus filter and Siri: a Focus can start and end sessions; "Focus on writing for 50 minutes" in Shortcuts.
• Pomly Focus for Safari (Mac), alongside Chrome. Free builds: Safari › Settings › Developer › Allow Unsigned Extensions.

In 1.0.4:

• Check for Updates: a button in Settings › Updates and, on Mac, in the Pomly menu.
• Safer Mac updates: the old app stays in place until the new one is ready, errors are shown, and an app outside Applications asks to be moved instead of retrying.

In 1.0.3:

• Fixed the New Label button, which did nothing on Mac. It now opens a small field on every platform.

In 1.0.2:

• Mac: the menu bar panel, drag line and guided drag now show over full-screen apps instead of on the desktop Space.

• Homebrew: brew tap tapariapurv/pomly https://github.com/tapariapurv/pomly && brew trust tapariapurv/pomly && brew install --cask pomly.
• One line: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tapariapurv/pomly/main/scripts/install.sh | bash.

iPhone, iPad & Apple Watch:

Sideload Pomly-iOS-unsigned.ipa with AltStore or Sideloadly (they sign it with your Apple ID), or build from source in Xcode. See the README.

Updates:

The Mac app updates itself from now on (Settings › Updates). On iPhone and iPad, add the AltStore source https://tapariapurv.github.io/pomly/altstore.json for automatic updates.

Highlights:

Drag-to-set dial · AlarmKit alarms · Live Activities & Dynamic Island · Home/Lock Screen/StandBy widgets · Control Center · Siri & Shortcuts · Mac menu bar timer with drag-to-set, mini timer and global shortcuts · Apple Watch app & complications · pairing-code sync · light & dark.

privacy.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Pomly finds free time in your day and adds finished focus sessions to a Pomly calendar.
